nodes.label: LLM Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Centralizes model access, timeout, retry, fallback, and structured JSON policy.

nodes.label: Evaluation-First Design
nodes.rationale: Makes agent behavior measurable, comparable, and improvable through shared evaluation utilities and standardized contracts.

nodes.label: NL2SQL Security Boundary
nodes.rationale: Treats LLM-generated SQL as untrusted and validates it before bounded execution with external access disabled.

nodes.label: Bring Your Own Key
nodes.rationale: Provider keys are held only in browser memory for the current page session and sent per request.

nodes.label: SQL Validator
nodes.rationale: Uses a deny-by-default parsed-AST, table, and function allowlist before execution.

nodes.label: Query Executor
nodes.rationale: Repeats validation, caps returned rows, and uses a DuckDB connection with external access and extension loading disabled.

nodes.label: Result Summarizer
nodes.rationale: Produces a concise answer grounded only in returned data.

nodes.label: Bounded Revision Loop
nodes.rationale: MAX_REVISIONS prevents infinite loops while allowing the writer to continue with the best available findings.

nodes.label: BYOK Handling
nodes.rationale: Synchronous keys are request-scoped; queued-job keys are Fernet-encrypted, expire after one hour, and are deleted when consumed or cancelled.

nodes.label: Generated-Code Execution Restriction
nodes.rationale: The debugging agent executes generated Python and is disabled from shared runtime surfaces unless explicitly enabled for non-production trusted-local use.
